criteria.requirement: Add keyword-only loads=None to JSONLIterator, selecting json.loads by default or a validated explicit callable. Call it once per nonblank candidate line, preserve exact returned object, reverse/rel_seek behavior and existing ignore_errors handling for decoder exceptions. Do not mutate global json.loads, preload the file, or close caller-owned streams. Validate decoder before reading or seeking; support Decimal parse_float and object_pairs_hook through caller-provided decoder functions.
